name: ai-employee-os
description: Local-first AI employee control plane for macOS

scripts.build: npm run build:native-memory && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.package:local: npm run build && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:release-metadata && node scripts/package_local_app.mjs
scripts.build:native-memory: mkdir -p build/native && xcrun clang -O2 -Wall -Wextra spikes/local-memory/memory_keychain_helper.c -framework Security -framework CoreFoundation -o build/native/memory-keychain-helper
